purpose_lock.real_job: Provide a repeatable scoring console for evaluating APEX artifacts before promotion.
purpose_lock.human_benefit: Helps reviewers understand whether an artifact is useful, testable, safe, and ready for the next stage.
purpose_lock.whole_system_usefulness: Makes quality judgment reusable, traceable, and evidence-aware across APEX modules.
purpose_lock.apex_governing_law_alignment: Prevents artifacts from advancing because they are impressive and requires purpose, evidence, scope, dignity, and system usefulness.

truth_boundary: Local deterministic evaluator tested in sandbox; not yet integrated into repository CI.
risk_register: Risk: scoring may not match human preference. Mitigation: require review and learning ledger.
Risk: false promotion. Mitigation: validator blocks production-ready claims and requires rollback/reseed path.
test_plan: Learn from reviewer feedback in next run.
